text:
### Observed differences

- The two hub activities traded prevalence. A02 was present in about 97 of 200 traces before and in all 200 after, with mean occurrences rising from 1.0 to about 1.8 per trace; A08 went from all 200 traces to about 90 of 200, with mean occurrences falling from 2.0 to about 0.8 [OCC002, OCC006]. A02 now sits near the start of traces (median relative position 0.0 vs 0.51 before) and A08 later (median 0.50 vs 0.10) [POS002, POS007].
- Routing changed at four points. Before, A02 always passed flow on to A01 and A08 split evenly between A03 and A04; after, A02 sends about 57% of its outgoing flow to A04 and 43% to A03, while A08 sends everything to A02. A03, previously always followed by A06, now leads to A01 in about 52% of its outgoing transitions and A06 in about 48%; A06, previously split between A02 (about 51%) and A07 (about 49%), now leads to A08 (about 53%) or A07 (about 47%) [DIR001, DIR004, DIR002, DIR003].
- Lags shift consistently with a one-step relocation: A02→A03 and A02→A04 moved from three steps apart to immediate; A08→A03 and A08→A04 lengthened from one step to two; A02→A01 lengthened from one step to two; the round-trip self-lags of A01, A02, A03 and A08 each shortened from five to four steps; A01→A08 stayed immediate [LAG011, LAG012, LAG041, LAG042, LAG009, LAG001, LAG010, LAG019, LAG046, LAG008].
- A01 became rarer and earlier: present in about 97 of 200 traces before vs 61 after, mean occurrences 1.0 → about 0.4, mean relative position 0.58 → 0.37 [OCC001, POS001].
- A06 and A07 thinned out: A06's mean occurrences fell from about 1.95 to 0.7 per trace (participation about 49% → 29%), and A07's participation halved from 31% to 15%, although A06's split between its two successors stayed roughly half-half [OCC004, OCC005, DIR003].
- Anchors stayed stable: A04 and A05 still occur in every trace in both windows, A04 at an essentially unchanged position (mean 0.70 vs 0.67), and A03's participation barely moved (about 49% → 45%) [POS004, REL003, REL004, OCC003, POS003].
- Pairwise relations flipped accordingly: A01–A02 went from co-occurring in about 49% of traces to A02-alone in about 70%; A02–A04 went from A04-alone in about 52% of traces to always co-occurring (A02 first in 55%); A04–A08 went from always co-occurring to A04-alone in 55% [REL001, REL009, REL021].

### Inference

Support level: Supported hypothesis

The evidence supports a structural rerouting in which A02 and A08 exchanged their places in the recurring cycle and A01 was displaced. Before, the flow typically ran A08 → A03 (or A04) → A06 → A02 → A01 and back to A08, with A07 able to replace A02; A08 was mandatory and A02 optional. In the later window, A02 is the mandatory hub branching to A04 (about 57%) or A03 (about 43%), the cycle runs A02 → A03 → A06 → A08 and back to A02 (or A02 → A03 → A01 → A08), A08 appears after A06 in about 45 in 100 traces, and A01 — previously directly after A02 — now hangs off A03 (A03 → A01 → A08) in about 31 in 100 traces. The reduced repetition of A06 and the halving of A07 follow from the same shortened loop [DIR001, DIR002, DIR003, DIR004, LAG009, LAG011, LAG012, LAG041, LAG042, LAG001, LAG010, LAG019, LAG046, OCC002, OCC006, OCC001, OCC004, OCC005].

The hypothesis is directly and consistently supported: the successor profiles of A02, A03, A06 and A08 all changed in the direction the exchange implies, the lag shifts match a one-step relocation, and the stable behaviour of A03, A04 and A05 argues against a global position shift; nearly every item shows a difference larger than in about 199 of 200 random re-splits of the pooled windows [DIR001, DIR002, DIR003, DIR004, LAG011, LAG042, POS004, POS003, REL003, OCC003]. Limitations: the evidence contains no screening baseline, so the item count cannot be checked against a chance expectation; with 200 traces per window the exact branch shares (for example 57/43 after A02) are point estimates that sampling noise could move by several points; and the evidence cannot distinguish one coordinated exchange from step-wise rewiring producing the same edges [DIR001, OCC002].

Other differences: only minor drifts that fit the same rerouting — A06 and A07 occur slightly later within traces (mean relative position up by about 0.03–0.04) [POS005, POS006].
